name: Classic Chocolate Chip Cookies
description: Chewy cookies with crisp edges and chocolate chunks.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line baking sheets.
Cream butter with granulated sugar and brown sugar until fluffy, then beat in eggs and vanilla extract.
Whisk flour with baking soda and salt, then mix it into the butter mixture and fold in chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto the sheets and bake for 9 to 11 minutes until the edges are golden.

name: Oatmeal Raisin Cookies
description: Soft spiced oatmeal cookies with raisins.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line baking sheets.
Cream butter with both sugars, beat in eggs and vanilla, then stir in raisins.
Combine flour, oats, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt; mix into the wet ingredients.
Scoop onto the sheets and bake 10 to 12 minutes until set.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies
description: Tender peanut butter cookies with a classic fork pattern.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a baking sheet.
Stir peanut butter, sugar, egg, oil, and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in almond flour, baking soda, and salt to make a soft dough.
Roll into balls, press with a fork, and bake 9 to 10 minutes.

name: Lemon Shortbread Cookies
description: Buttery shortbread brightened with lemon zest.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar with lemon zest until pale, then mix in egg yolk, lemon juice, and vanilla.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt; stir into the butter mixture to make a soft dough.
Chill the dough for 30 minutes, roll it out, and cut into rounds.
Bake at 325 F for 12 to 14 minutes until the edges are lightly golden.

name: Vegan Double Chocolate Cookies
description: Rich cocoa cookies made without dairy or eggs.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line baking sheets.
Whisk flour, cocoa, baking soda, and salt in a bowl.
Stir coconut oil with both sugars, applesauce, water, and vanilla; fold in the dry mixture and vegan chocolate chips.
Scoop dough onto the sheets and bake 10 to 12 minutes.

name: Gluten-Free Almond Cookies
description: Chewy almond cookies with a delicate crisp crust.
instructions: Heat the oven to 325 F and line a baking sheet.
Whisk almond flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Beat egg whites until foamy, then stir in oil, lemon juice, and vanilla; fold in the almond mixture.
Shape into small rounds and bake 12 to 13 minutes until lightly browned.

name: Fudgy Brownies
description: Dense chocolate brownies with a shiny crackled top.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a square pan.
Melt dark chocolate with butter and let it cool slightly, then whisk in sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Fold in flour, cocoa, baking powder, salt, and walnuts just until combined.
Spread in the pan and bake about 28 minutes; cool before slicing.

name: Walnut Brownies
description: Classic cocoa brownies with toasted walnuts.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a square pan.
Melt butter and whisk in cocoa and sugar; beat in eggs and vanilla.
Fold in flour, baking powder, salt, and walnuts.
Bake 28 to 30 minutes until the center is just set, then cool.

name: Vegan Sweet Potato Brownies
description: Moist cocoa brownies naturally sweetened with sweet potato.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a square pan.
Whisk sweet potato puree with brown sugar, coconut oil, water, and vanilla.
Stir in cocoa, certified gluten-free oat flour, baking powder, and salt, then fold in vegan chocolate chips.
Spread in the pan and bake about 25 minutes until firm at the edges.

name: Gluten-Free Tahini Brownies
description: Fudgy sesame brownies made with almond flour.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a square pan.
Whisk tahini, sugar, eggs, maple syrup, and vanilla until smooth.
Fold in cocoa, almond flour, baking powder, salt, and chopped dark chocolate.
Bake 22 to 24 minutes and cool fully before cutting.

name: No-Knead Country Bread
description: Crusty artisan loaf with a chewy open crumb.
instructions: Stir water with yeast and sugar and let it stand until foamy.
Mix in bread flour, salt, and olive oil until a shaggy dough forms.
Cover and leave at room temperature overnight, then shape the risen dough.
Bake in a preheated covered pot at 450 F for 30 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered.

name: Whole Wheat Sandwich Bread
description: Soft everyday loaf with a mild nutty flavor.
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and let foam.
Mix whole wheat flour, bread flour, salt, and olive oil into the yeast mixture.
Knead until smooth, let rise until doubled, then shape into a loaf and rise again.
Bake at 375 F for about 35 minutes until the loaf sounds hollow.

name: Banana Bread
description: Moist quick bread made with ripe bananas.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a loaf pan.
Mash bananas and mix with melted butter, brown sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Whisk flour, baking soda, salt, and cinnamon, then fold into the banana mixture.
Bake 50 to 55 minutes until a tester comes out clean.

name: Rosemary Focaccia
description: Olive oil rich bread topped with rosemary and sea salt.
instructions: Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water and leave until foamy.
Mix bread flour, fine salt, and half the olive oil into a soft dough; knead briefly and let rise until airy.
Press dough into an oiled pan, dimple it, and drizzle with the remaining olive oil.
Top with rosemary and coarse sea salt, then bake at 425 F for about 25 minutes.

name: Gluten-Free Seeded Loaf
description: Hearty gluten-free loaf packed with seeds.
instructions: Whisk warm water with psyllium husk and let it gel for 5 minutes.
Stir in yeast, honey, olive oil, gluten-free flour blend, and salt to make a thick dough; fold in sunflower seeds.
Rest until slightly risen, then transfer to a loaf pan and smooth the top.
Bake at 375 F for about 50 minutes and cool completely before slicing.

name: Blueberry Muffins
description: Fluffy muffins filled with juicy blueberries.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a muffin pan.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk melted butter with eggs, milk, and vanilla, then fold into the dry mixture and gently add blueberries.
Divide among 12 cups and bake about 22 minutes until golden.

name: Apple Cinnamon Muffins
description: Tender muffins with fresh apple and cinnamon.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a muffin pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, cinnamon, and salt.
Beat sugar with oil, eggs, milk, and vanilla; fold in the flour mixture and diced apple.
Divide into 12 cups and bake 21 to 23 minutes until a tester comes out clean.

name: Vegan Chocolate Chip Muffins
description: Dairy-free muffins with chocolate chips.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a muffin pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Stir brown sugar, oil, applesauce, coconut cream, water, and vanilla together; fold in the dry mixture and vegan chocolate chips.
Divide among 12 cups and bake about 20 minutes until risen and golden.

name: Gluten-Free Lemon Poppy Seed Muffins
description: Bright lemon muffins with a tender gluten-free crumb.
instructions: Heat the oven to 375 F and line a muffin pan.
Whisk gluten-free flour blend with poppy seeds, baking powder, and salt.
Beat butter and sugar, then mix in eggs, yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest.
Fold in the dry ingredients, divide among 12 cups, and bake about 21 minutes.

name: Vanilla Birthday Cake
description: Soft vanilla layer cake with a simple buttercream.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease two round pans.
Whisk cake flour with baking powder and salt.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs and vanilla, then add the flour mixture alternately with milk.
Divide between pans and bake about 30 minutes; cool before frosting.

name: Carrot Cake
description: Spiced carrot cake with a moist crumb.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a cake pan.
Whisk flour, baking soda, cinnamon, and salt.
Beat sugar, oil, eggs, and vanilla; fold in carrots, pineapple, and walnuts.
Stir in the dry mixture and bake about 40 minutes until the center springs back.

name: Vegan Chocolate Cake
description: Deep chocolate cake made without dairy or eggs.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a cake pan.
Whisk flour, cocoa, sugar, baking soda, and salt.
Stir water with oil, vinegar, and vanilla, then mix into the dry ingredients until smooth.
Bake about 34 minutes until a tester comes out clean.

name: Flourless Chocolate Cake
description: Rich, naturally gluten-free chocolate dessert cake.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a cake pan.
Melt dark chocolate with butter and let it cool slightly.
Whisk eggs with sugar and vanilla until thick, then fold in cocoa, baking powder, and salt.
Fold in the melted chocolate mixture, pour into the pan, and bake about 28 minutes; chill before serving.

name: Lemon Drizzle Cake
description: Light loaf cake finished with a tart lemon glaze.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a loaf pan.
Cream butter and sugar, then beat in eggs, vanilla, lemon zest, and juice from the lemons.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt, then fold into the butter mixture alternately with milk.
Bake about 45 minutes until a tester comes out clean; cool before slicing.

name: Vegan Coconut Cake
description: Tender coconut cake with plant-based ingredients.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and grease a cake pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Stir sugar, coconut oil, coconut cream, applesauce, and vanilla until smooth; fold in the dry ingredients and shredded coconut.
Bake 30 to 32 minutes until golden and springy.

name: French Macarons
description: Delicate almond meringue cookies with smooth shells and a crisp-chewy center.
instructions: Sift almond flour with 1 3/4 cups powdered sugar and salt.
Whip egg whites with cream of tartar to foamy peaks, gradually add granulated sugar, then whip to stiff peaks and mix in vanilla.
Fold in the almond mixture, pipe rounds, rest until dry to the touch, and bake at 300 F for 14 to 16 minutes.
Beat butter with the remaining powdered sugar for filling, cool the shells, and sandwich them with the butter filling.

name: Classic Baked Cheesecake
description: Creamy vanilla cheesecake on a buttery graham cracker crust.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F; mix graham cracker crumbs with melted butter and press into a springform pan.
Beat cream cheese with sugar and salt until smooth, then mix in eggs one at a time.
Stir in sour cream, vanilla, and lemon juice; pour filling over the crust.
Bake at 325 F until just set, cool gradually, and chill at least 4 hours.

name: Soft Cinnamon Rolls
description: Pillowy yeast rolls filled with cinnamon sugar and finished with vanilla glaze.
instructions: Bloom yeast in warm milk with a teaspoon of granulated sugar.
Mix flour, remaining granulated sugar, salt, egg, and softened butter with the yeast mixture; knead and let rise until doubled.
Roll out the dough, spread with more softened butter, and sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon.
Roll, slice, and proof until puffy; bake at 350 F for 20 to 25 minutes.
Whisk powdered sugar, vanilla, and water into a glaze and drizzle over the warm rolls.

name: Buttermilk Scones
description: Tender, flaky breakfast scones with lightly crisp tops.
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 F and line a baking sheet.
Whisk flour, sugar, baking powder, and salt.
Cut in cold butter until pea-sized, then stir in buttermilk, egg, and vanilla just until a dough forms.
Shape into a round, cut into wedges, and bake 16 to 18 minutes until golden.

name: Classic Sugar Cookies
description: Buttery sugar cookies that hold their shape and decorate beautifully.
instructions: Cream butter and sugar until pale and fluffy.
Beat in egg, vanilla, and milk.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt, then mix into the butter mixture; chill the dough for 30 minutes.
Roll and cut shapes, then bake at 350 F for 8 to 10 minutes until edges are set.

name: Classic Apple Pie
description: Flaky double crust filled with cinnamon-spiced apples.
instructions: Heat the oven to 425 F. Cut cold butter into flour and salt, add cold water until the pastry holds together, divide, and chill.
Slice apples and toss with sugar, cinnamon, lemon juice, and cornstarch.
Roll one pastry portion into a pie plate, add the apple filling, cover with the second pastry portion, and seal the edges.
Vent the top and bake 20 minutes, then reduce heat to 375 F and bake about 35 minutes until bubbling; cool before slicing.

name: Vanilla Cupcakes
description: Light vanilla cupcakes topped with a simple buttercream frosting.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a 12-cup muffin pan.
Whisk flour, baking powder, and salt.
Cream butter and sugar, beat in eggs and vanilla, then add the flour mixture alternately with milk.
Divide batter among cups and bake 18 to 20 minutes; cool before frosting.

name: Butter Croissants
description: Laminated French pastries with crisp golden layers and a tender center.
instructions: Dissolve yeast and a little sugar in warm milk; mix with bread flour, remaining sugar, salt, and water into a dough and chill.
Enclose the cold butter in the dough, then roll and fold it in three turns, chilling between each turn.
Roll out, cut into triangles, shape into crescents, and proof until puffy.
Bake at 400 F for about 20 minutes until deeply golden.

name: Banana Muffins
description: Moist, tender muffins made with ripe bananas and a hint of cinnamon.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a muffin pan.
Mash bananas and stir in melted butter, sugar, eggs, and vanilla.
Whisk flour, cinnamon, baking soda, and salt, then fold into the banana mixture.
Divide among 12 cups and bake 20 to 22 minutes.

name: Skillet Cornbread
description: Golden, tender cornbread with crisp buttery edges.
instructions: Heat the oven to 400 F and warm a greased cast-iron skillet.
Whisk cornmeal, flour, baking powder, and salt.
Whisk buttermilk with eggs, melted butter, and honey, then fold into the dry ingredients.
Pour batter into the hot skillet and bake 20 to 22 minutes until golden.

name: Fluffy Buttermilk Pancakes
description: Soft breakfast pancakes with crisp edges and a light, airy crumb.
instructions: Whisk flour, baking powder, sugar, and salt.
Whisk buttermilk with egg, melted butter, and vanilla, then stir into the dry ingredients until just combined.
Rest the batter for 5 minutes while a lightly greased griddle heats over medium heat.
Cook pancakes until bubbles form, flip, and cook the second side until golden.

name: Tangy Lemon Bars
description: Bright lemon curd baked over a buttery shortbread crust and dusted with sugar.
instructions: Heat the oven to 350 F and line a square pan.
Mix flour, butter, powdered sugar, and salt; press into the pan and bake for 18 to 20 minutes.
Whisk granulated sugar, eggs, lemon juice, lemon zest, and baking powder until smooth.
Pour filling over the warm crust and bake 20 to 25 minutes until just set; cool and chill before cutting.
